steps.title: Create Project Directories
steps.command: mkdir fullstack-app && cd fullstack-app && mkdir client server
steps.description: Generates a parent folder containing isolated directories for the frontend client and backend server.

steps.title: Setup Node.js Backend Engine
steps.command: cd server && npm init -y && npm install express cors dotenv && npm install --save-dev nodemon
steps.description: Initializes package management inside the server directory and provisions Express router architectures with dynamic reloading.

steps.title: Setup React Frontend Interface
steps.command: cd ../client && npm create vite@latest . -- --template react && npm install
steps.description: Installs a streamlined React engine using Vite for rapid modular browser bundles directly in the client workspace.

steps.title: Execute Development Environments
steps.command: Parallel terminal execution: [server] npm run dev | [client] npm run dev
steps.description: Launches the Node backend api (typically on port 5000/8080) concurrently alongside the Vite client pipeline (typically port 5173).
